advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 10/14 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.552 over 14 corners (9 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Fronts lock first: brake balance 2-4% rearward.
advice.evidence: median deficit F 0.27 vs R 0.14; 4/7 stops

advice.text: Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
advice.evidence: median F 210 F vs R 188 F

advice.text: Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.79) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
